SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
S.2. **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date. January 1st, 1938

Subject: Intelligence Enquiry re: Scott.

Made by D.S. Jones    Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

（批：Mr Grome informed by telephone. W.G. Jan.）

In answer to the enquiry as to whether Scott is alive and well, I can definitely state that he is alive, for I managed to get into touch with certain people who have seen him about town during the past few days. At present he trying to get a job in the publicity business through the Anzac Association. So far as can be ascertained he is in good health.

His address is :
House No. 8,
Lane 56,
Nanyang Road.

D.S. Jones
D.S.

D.S. Special Branch

事由：关于斯科特（Scott）的情报查询。

由 D.S. Jones 制作    转呈由 **〔此处转录不清〕**

POLICE FORCE.
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, January 14 1935
To S.

An Australian named
Scott, who was employed

know if Scott is alive and
well. Please ascertain
if he is.
D.S. Jones. SM. (Initials)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTER.
File No. D
SECRET REPORT
S. 2, Special Branch.
Date March 2, 1935.

Subject Letter dated 28.1.35 from the British Consulate-General
regarding a communist suspect named Ong Giap Un ( 王業運 ), a
student of the Fu Tan High School ( 復旦實驗中學 ), Kiangwan.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

Careful enquiries made by the Chinese staff of
Section 2, Special Branch, elicit the information that Ong Giap
Un ( 王業運 ) c/o Fu Tan High School, Kiangwan, Shanghai, who
is known to act as a communication agent between the Malay
Communist Party and members of the Central Executive Committee
of the Chinese Communist Party, is a two-and-a-half-year grade
student of the Futan High School, Kiangwan. He is a native
of a South Sea Island, 25 years of age, about 5'4" in height,
dark complexion, usually dresses in foreign style clothing.
According to information gathered from certain of his schoolmates,
Ong is known to be a truant and keeps his movements secret.

Particulars concerning this individual have been duly
passed to the Chinese Authorities and a record of same has been
made by this office for future reference.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).
File
〔此处转录不清〕

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别处登记室。
档案号 D
秘密报告
S. 2, 特别处。
日期：1935年3月2日。

事由：英国驻沪总领事馆1月28日来函，
提及一名名为翁吉云（Ong Giap Un，王業運）的共产主义嫌疑分子，
系江湾复旦实验中学（Fu Tan High School，復旦實驗中學）的学生。

由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）制作。转呈由 〔此处转录不清〕

经特别处第二科华籍职员仔细查询，获悉如下信息：翁吉云（王業運），通讯处为上海江湾复旦实验中学，已知其在马来亚共产党与中国共产党中央执行委员会成员之间充当联络代理人，系江湾复旦实验中学二年级半的学生。他是南洋群岛某地人，年龄25岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，肤色黝黑，通常穿着西式服装。根据从其部分同学处收集的信息，翁某已知有逃学行为，且行踪隐秘。

关于此人的详细资料已 duly 移交给中国当局，本处已为此存档以备将来参考。

顾宝华
督察

副总监（特别处）。
档案
〔此处转录不清〕

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 280. SHANGHAI.
28th January, 1935.
MUNICIPAL [ ]
S. B. REGI [ ]
D 6415
[ ] / [ ]

My dear Givens,

Very many thanks for your letter of
25th January forwarding me details of Lin Hiung
obtained through the courtesy of the Public Safety
Bureau.

You may perhaps care to inform them
in return that the following person is known to act as
an accommodation address for communist correspondence
between the Malayan Communist Party and members of the
Central Executive Committee of the Chinese Communist
Party and also is a friend of Lin Hiung.

Ong Giap Un ( 王業運 )
c/o Fu Tan High School ( 復旦實驗中學 )
Kiangwan, Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,
D. C. Kuh [Signature] 3/2. [Signature]

T. I. Givens, Esq.,
Special Branch,
S. M. P.

（批：Roy: Please attach file. JAG attached JAN 30 1935）
（批：S2, Please see Mr Hopkins and ascertain who the person is. Seen DMR 3/1 JAG）

1935年1月28日。
公共租界 [ ]
特别处登记 [ ]
D 6415
[ ] / [ ]

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

非常感谢你1月25日的来信，
承蒙公共安全局的好意，
向我提供了林熊（Lin Hiung）的详细资料。

你或许愿意反过来告知他们，
已知以下人员为马来亚共产党与
中国共产党中央执行委员会成员之间的
共产主义信件提供通信地址，
同时也是林熊的朋友。

翁吉云（王業運）
通讯处：上海江湾复旦实验中学（復旦實驗中學）

此致
敬礼，
D. C. Kuh [签名] 3/2. [签名]

T. I. Givens 先生，
特别处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
D 6415
Date 15 / 1 / 35

January 15 35.

SECRET

Mr. Hwang Hun,
Chief of the 3rd Division,
Public Safety Bureau.

Sir,

I have the honour to request that you
will kindly furnish for record purposes, the
finger prints and photograph of Lin Hsiung who
is a prisoner in the 2nd Prison of Kiangsu at
Zau Oe Ching where he is serving a term as
Convict No. 173.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)
